نستضيء (form X)
# نَسْتَضِيءُ (nastaḍīʔu) /nas.ta.dˤiː.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَضَاءَ (istaḍāʔa)
# نَسْتَضِيءَ (nastaḍīʔa) /nas.ta.dˤiː.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَضَاءَ (istaḍāʔa)
